{{Quote|Reporting on the side of peace and justice, this is Rule Davenbay.|Rule Davenbay|audio=BetterTaglineThanCronkite-HNNAGD3.flac|<ref name="HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided (Part 3)">[[HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided (Part 3)|''HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided'' (Part 3)]]</ref>}}
'''Rule Davenbay''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] anchor working at [[Dateline Coruscant]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Biography==
He reported on the [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] attacks on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia's]] supply lines, as well as the approval rating of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] early on in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
